messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — trying to lock the design partner acceptance criteria and the micro-survey onboarding flow by EOD Fri. Can we get alignment on must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
Mike: +1. We should keep the initial scope minimal: signed NDA, infra access, 1 integration spike, 3 weeks of feedback.
Teri: Agreed. Also need a response SLA from partners for surveys — target 70% within 48h.
Jordan: 70% sounds reasonable. For the integration spike, do we want them to run a perf test against their typical workload?
Alyssa: Yes, JS/REST sample + perf doc. Need data for batching/quant recommendations.
Nadia: For incentives — propose $500 credits + early access badge + 1 hour implementation support. Thoughts? :money_with_wings:
Mike: Works. Add co-marketing option if they hit milestones. Keeps them engaged.
Teri: Can we define the weekly touchpoints? I suggest: 30m kickoff, weekly 30m check-in, asynchronous async report in a shared Google doc.
Alyssa: That matches my thinking. Also want a short micro-survey after each weekly sync (3 questions) so we can capture qualitative + NPS-ish signal.
Jordan: Draft micro-survey (short):
```
1) What went well this week? (1-2 lines)
2) Any regressions/quality issues observed? (Y/N + brief)
3) Overall confidence in using Redwood for this flow (1-5)
```
Alyssa: Perfect. Keep it lightweight. We'll automate a reminder at 24h if unanswered.
Nadia: Who owns automation? Can product ops wire up a simple Google Form + reminder bot?
Mike: Product ops owns setup, eng provides the webhook to link responses to the tracker.
Teri: Tracker = shared spreadsheet with these columns: partner, week, q1, q2, q3, action items, owner.
Alyssa: Launch criteria (proposal):
- 3 design partners onboarded
- ≥70% weekly survey response rate for 2 consecutive weeks
- No showstopper regressions (severity P0) in evaluation prompts
- Integration docs validated by partner engineers

Jordan: Add "support SLA defined and accepted" to criteria (oncall contacts, escalation path).
Alyssa: Good call. Add that.
Nadia: One more: data handling & privacy checklist signed (for private/dedicated partners).
Mike: Agree. For private deploys we need KMS/HSM confirmation.
Teri: Timing: propose cohort start date Mon Jul 10 (two-week onboarding window), 3-week active feedback window, then decision checkpoint.
Alyssa: If we aim for Jul 10 start, we need invites out by next Tue. Recruiting message draft: short ask, highlight incentives, time commitment, and NDA link.
Jordan: I can draft the outreach blurb. Will ping legal for NDA shortlink.
Nadia: Also plan for a single technical intake form so eng has the minimal info (model, avg seq len, tokens/session, auth type).
Mike: Example intake snippet for eng:```
- model: gptx-2b
- avg_tokens_per_request: 120
- concurrency target: 5 rps
- data_sensitivity: low/medium/high
```
Teri: Nice. Keep it copy-pasteable.
Alyssa: One open question: do we require partners to use our SDK or allow raw REST? My preference: prefer SDK for telemetry but allow REST if they can't.
Jordan: Make SDK recommended, not required. We'll include a short "how to enable telemetry" blurb for REST users.
Nadia: Ops note: ensure we have a per-partner rate limit bump request flow documented before onboarding.
Mike: I'll add that to the onboarding playbook.
Alyssa: Risks to call out in the doc: low survey engagement, long onboarding due to infra differences, and regression noise. We need contingency: fallback to 1:1 interviews if survey engagement <40%.
Teri: Good fallback. Also propose a mid-cohort pulse review to rebalance workload across eng.
Jordan: I'll add a cadence: Day 0 kickoff, Day 7 pulse, Day 14 intermediate review, Day 21 final review.
Alyssa: Can someone assemble the final acceptance checklist + outreach copy today?
Jordan: I got outreach. Mike will own playbook updates, Nadia will confirm privacy checklist, Teri will wire the tracker, Alyssa will approve final doc.
Nadia: On it. Legal loop started. Expect NDA link in ~24h.
oncall-bot: Reminder set — "DP cohort outreach send" scheduled for 2024-07-02 09:00 UTC.
Alyssa: Thanks team :rocket: Let's reconvene briefly tomorrow if there are blockers.
